assessment.summary: A complete, technically faithful translation with several visible Spanish-language defects. Correct the subtitle, group-label inconsistency, grammar and answer wording before publication; the other suggestions are optional voice and style polish.

sourceConcerns: The English title «Symbols as Non-Enumerable Keys» implies symbol-keyed properties cannot be enumerable, while its explanation correctly says they can have their own `enumerable` flag. The Spanish title inherits this issue; any factual retitling needs source review.

The English question «retrieve all Symbol keys of an object» can suggest inherited keys, but `Object.getOwnPropertySymbols()` returns own symbol keys only, as the English explanation later specifies. The Spanish question inherits this ambiguity.
